name: Terran
description: Temperate continents and shallow seas. The easiest world to live on and the hardest to find.

name: Ocean
description: A water world with scattered archipelagos. Rich in life and research opportunities.

name: Jungle
description: Hot, wet and overgrown. Food is everywhere; so is everything that eats it.

name: Arid
description: Dry steppe and salt flats under a hard sky. Poor farmland but rich in ore.

name: Tundra
description: Permafrost plains and brief summers. Hardy settlers find minerals under the ice.

name: Desert
description: Endless dunes and exposed bedrock. Nothing grows, but the mining is excellent.

name: Arctic
description: A frozen shell over a dark sea. Isolated research stations thrive in the silence.

name: Lava
description: A young, molten world. Brutal to live on and unmatched for heavy industry.

name: Barren
description: Airless rock pocked with craters. Only domes and tunnels make it habitable.

name: Gas Giant
description: Banded clouds over a crushing abyss. Floating cities skim rare gases from the storms.

name: Asteroid Belt
description: A ring of rubble that never became a planet. Pure mining territory.
